title: Banner Replacement, Shop Toggle Fix, Admin Redesign & Delivery Logic

requirements.text: Replace all vegetable/sabji-themed banners in the HeroBannerCarousel with professional general grocery banners showcasing Rice, Oil, Biscuits, and Snacks. Remove any vegetable or sabji imagery from the homepage entirely.

quotes: Remove all images and banners related to vegetables/sabji. This is a General Grocery Store. Replace them with professional grocery banners (Rice, Oil, Biscuits, Snacks).

acceptanceCriteria: No vegetable or sabji images appear anywhere on the homepage
HeroBannerCarousel displays at least 2 banners featuring Rice, Oil, Biscuits, or Snacks themes
New banners look professional and match a general grocery store aesthetic

requirements.text: Delete the existing ShopStatusToggle component code entirely and rewrite it from scratch. The new toggle must call the backend mutation directly and optimistically update UI. When the shop is set to 'Closed': (1) immediately display the ShopClosedBanner on the homepage, (2) disable all 'Add to Cart' buttons across every ProductCard, and (3) block checkout navigation from the CartDrawer. When set to 'Open', all restrictions are lifted immediately.

quotes: The On/Off toggle is still not working. Delete the old toggle code and rewrite it. It must link directly to the database. When I click 'Close', the website must immediately show the 'Shop Closed' banner and disable all 'Add to Cart' buttons.

acceptanceCriteria: Toggling to 'Closed' in the admin panel immediately persists the closed state to the backend
ShopClosedBanner appears on the homepage without requiring a page reload after closing
All 'Add to Cart' buttons are visually disabled and non-functional when shop is closed
CartDrawer prevents navigation to checkout when shop is closed
Toggling back to 'Open' re-enables all Add to Cart buttons and hides the closed banner immediately

requirements.text: Redesign the AdminPage with a dark/blue dashboard theme. Replace the current layout with a stats overview row at the top containing three clean metric cards: 'Total Orders' (showing order count), 'Active Users' (showing distinct users with orders), and 'Shop Status' (showing current open/closed state with color indicator). Apply a dark navy/slate background, white/light text, and blue accent colors throughout the admin panel tabs and cards.

quotes: The Admin Panel looks unprofessional. Redesign it using a Dark/Blue Dashboard Theme. Use clean cards for 'Total Orders', 'Active Users', and 'Shop Status'.

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel uses a dark navy/slate background with blue accent colors
Three stat cards are visible at the top: Total Orders, Active Users, Shop Status
Each stat card displays a live value fetched from the backend
Shop Status card shows green when open and red when closed
All tabs (Orders, Products, Settings, Bills) are restyled to match the dark/blue theme
Admin panel looks professional and clean on both desktop and mobile

requirements.text: Ensure the 'Delivery in 10 Mins' badge is rendered on every ProductCard without exception. Verify that the free delivery threshold logic (free delivery for orders ₹51 and above, ₹5 charge below ₹51 within 1km) is enforced in the CartDrawer total calculation and on the CheckoutPage order summary.

quotes: Ensure the 'Delivery in 10 Mins' badge is visible on every product and the ₹51 free delivery logic is active

acceptanceCriteria: 'Delivery in 10 Mins' badge is visible on every product card in the grid
Cart total below ₹51 shows a ₹5 delivery charge
Cart total of ₹51 or above shows free delivery (₹0 delivery charge)
Delivery fee dynamically updates as items are added or removed from cart
CheckoutPage order summary reflects the correct delivery fee

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
All backend state changes must go through the existing single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo
Shop open/closed state must be persisted to the backend — do not use localStorage or sessionStorage as the source of truth for shop status
nonGoals: Adding new backend data fields beyond what is needed for shop status toggle and stats
Redesigning the customer-facing pages (checkout, my orders, wallet)
Changing the store name or PWA manifest

required: Professional grocery store promotional banner featuring a bag of Basmati rice, cooking oil bottle, and warm golden tones on a clean white background (grocery-banner-rice-oil.dim_1200x400.png)
Professional grocery store promotional banner featuring biscuit packets and snack bags arranged neatly with a vibrant orange and yellow background (grocery-banner-biscuits-snacks.dim_1200x400.png)
